approval_source.question_set: R03 window moved forward: "this can be done now" (10 November 2026)

reason: The user moved the transaction-flood half of R03 from Thursday 12 November to the same day. Everything else in P01_T06_R03_LOAD_MACHINES_RUN_2026-11-10 stands.

decisions.question: When
decisions.selected: Tuesday 10 November 2026, 17:00-21:00 UTC (transaction floods, 2 machines, at most 4 hours)
decisions.rule: Replaces only the Thursday window of P01_T06_R03_LOAD_MACHINES_RUN_2026-11-10; the request floods still wait for their own window.

accepted_risks: The staging sentry runs at its production limits under the floods; the staging chain may slow or refuse honest traffic for the window. That is what the run measures.
Load machines share the hosts' Hetzner project; deletion is guarded by label, name and delete protection, and load_machines.py check runs before and after.
does_not_authorize: more than the machines, hours and window named here
rebuilding either host or lifting a host's delete protection
